title.narrative: Strengthening the Catholic Church’s prophetic voice - Phase 6 project

description.narrative: The sixth phase project is centered on addressing the key areas identified by SECAM in response to the challenges faced by the African continent. The project will seek to consolidate progress made in the thematic areas pursued during the previous project phase and now clearly outlined in the updated MoU with AU, which among others, endeavors: • To strengthen the parties’ collective efforts of promoting good governance, democracy and the rule of law in Africa • To enhance the parties’ collective efforts of promoting peacebuilding and conflict resolution in Africa, thus contributing to stability and development across the continent • To complement each party’s initiatives aimed at addressing humanitarian crises and improving the well-being of communities in need • To promote mutual initiatives addressing Climate Change, through the preservation of the Earth, integrity of creation and sustainable use of natural resources
